title: drain_once dead/ scan duplicates read_dir loop already used for live queue
description: drain_once contains two nearly identical read_dir loop structures (lines 311-333 for queue dir, lines 341-363 for dead/ dir). The dead/ scan is a reduced version of the first with a count instead of collecting paths. A helper fn count_env_files(dir: &Path) -> (usize, Option<io::Error>) would reduce the duplication and give the dead/ scan consistent error handling with the main scan.
